user.title: Ruckus controller
user.description: Log in to your Ruckus Unleashed / ZoneDirector controller. If Home Assistant's own Ruckus integration is set up, the address and user are filled in and you can leave the password empty to reuse its password.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Unleashed master AP (or ZoneDirector).
data_description.password: Leave empty to reuse the password of the built-in Ruckus integration.

clients.title: Clients to measure
clients.description: Pick the Wi-Fi clients (for example your TVs) that should get a throughput sensor. Only connected clients are listed; you can also type a MAC address.

data_description.clients: One 'Wi-Fi throughput' sensor (kbit/s, download + upload) is created per client.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (seconds) the controller is asked for the counters. 30 s is a good balance.

error.cannot_connect: Could not log in to the controller - check the address, user and password.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.

init.title: Clients to measure
init.description: Add or remove clients, or change how often the counters are read.
